d:
Lilybell, who lives alone in the forest, encounters
a beastman youth named Tail who has collapsed one day . Lilybell nurses Tail back to health, but when he wakes up, he has lost all memory of what happened before he collapsed. Lilybell promises to let Tail stay in her home for a limited time, until he regains his memory . However, as she spends time with the gentle and gentlemanly Tail, Lilybell gradually becomes attracted to him and develops a faint love for him. Before long, she finds herself wishing that he would stay by her side forever, since his memory will never return ... ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This is a story about a petite protagonist who has an erotic mark branded into her uterus by a beastman youth, is made to experience multiple orgasms without any sexual knowledge, and has her body reshaped to accept him. Includes cross-sections, a pregnant belly, and some mild scatological depictions. A sample of the opening pages is available on
n: [Doujinshi] The howling wolf never forgets its promise.
